{{Quote|Ordo, Kelborn, Itera. They all recovered.|[[Torian Cadera]], discussing the clans that had rebelled against [[Mandalore the Vindicated]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Clan Itera''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence following the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="TOR" /> When [[Jicoln Cadera]] [[Crusader's schism|rebelled]] against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-favoring reign of [[Mandalore the Vindicated]],<ref name="Mandalore">{{HolonetOld|biographies|mandalore|Mandalore}}</ref> Clan Itera was one of several clans that rallied to Cadera's side. Cadera and [[Clan Cadera|his clan's]] movement was defeated, Clan Itera was accepted back by [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], and continued to be a respected part of the Mandalorian culture.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Itera was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
